author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hello, fellow Avicus forum user!
Eggs were an extremely fun part of Nebula; it was a big shame when they were removed.
So, my question to you is: "Why not add them back?"
The Nebula Shop obviously needs some improvements, and this might be where to start. I'm envisioning them being 30 points and everyone can buy them (like the EULA states).
With the new point system in which you don't get points for breaking monuments, they'd be quite hard to get, which would solve the problem of too many people having them, and they'd be well worth it. 
Maybe even buff and bring back the TNT while we're at it?
Anyone else agree?

replies.author: ShiptheBattle
replies.body:
In my opinion, I never liked grenades/eggs. 
If you were kill-farming correctly and not breaking any rules, it would be a shame to get blown up in a matter of seconds by approximately 5 eggs. 
Especially when one player has racked up so many points that they are capable of destroying a whole defense or kill farm with grenades alone. 
To that, -1. 

The TNT however, I would give a +1.
You know those extremely difficult defenses made out of wood and there's 3 floors and there's like 3 people defending each floor? That's pretty painful to attack, especially when the monument isn't covered and the defenders are pros like, Warbry, SnowGolemKirby, etc... (Just listing you two ;) XD) Anyways, a common way to attack a defense is sky-bridging and dropping TNT on the base would definitely make infiltrating their defense much easier. So, TNT should come back. :P
